source: New artwork generated for this project from the recorded original prompts; no third-party image packs, franchise characters, logos, named artists, or likeness references were requested.
rights_note: AI-assisted project artwork. Applicable service terms govern use; no guarantee of uniqueness, exclusive copyright, or comprehensive legal clearance is claimed. These assets do not relicense SRD material or the separate project code.
processing: Image generation followed by image-tool refinement of alpha cutouts and atlas spacing. Runtime sprite extraction and premultiplied-alpha bilinear scaling use the Python standard library; no runtime image-library dependency.

atlases.prompt: Original production game-art sprite atlas for an independent dark fantasy dungeon game. Realistically rendered materials and anatomy, cinematic physically plausible torchlight from upper left with a faint cool rim on the right. High detail readable at small game size: worn leather pores, natural skin creases, forged steel edges, restrained colors. All subjects are original generic fantasy designs, no existing franchise characters, no logos, no text, no captions, no borders, no checkerboard pattern. Truly transparent alpha background, no scenery or ground plane, separated cells with no overlap. Precise evenly spaced atlas layout. PORTRAIT CANVAS 1024 wide by 1536 high, exactly ONE column and THREE equal horizontal rows, each row a 1024x512 landscape first-person weapon overlay. Only the adventurer's hands, wrists and held equipment visible, no face, torso or full person. Hands enter from the bottom edge of EACH individual row and equipment rises toward center, intended to overlay a dungeon view. Keep all weapons inside their row, with generous transparent space toward top. TOP ROW: adult warrior's left hand behind a round battered iron-rimmed wooden shield at lower left, right anatomically natural gloved hand firmly gripping a realistic one-handed longsword at lower right, blade rises diagonally toward upper right; lifelike proper grip and five fingers. MIDDLE ROW: rogue's left open leather-gloved balancing hand low left, right leather-gloved hand gripping a slender forged steel rapier low right, blade pointing upward and inward, correct blade and hand proportions. BOTTOM ROW: wizard's left natural hand extended low left holding a small restrained blue-white arcane glow between fingertips, right hand low right gripping a detailed weathered wooden staff capped with a small quartz crystal, staff head rises to upper right. The three POV compositions must occupy separate exactly equal rows, all warm-lit, highly realistic, not cartoon or low-poly.
atlases.revision: Transparent cutouts and spacing refined with the image-generation tool.

atlases.revision: Axe head orientation corrected: broad bit on the left of the shaft, short poll on the right; original hands and other two grips retained.
atlases.correction_prompt: Edit the idle game-prop orientation in the BOTTOM panel of this sprite atlas. The axe head is mounted the wrong way around on its wooden shaft. Rotate only the metal head 180 degrees around the shaft: the large broad crescent bit must extend to the LEFT of the shaft and the short poll must extend to the RIGHT. Keep the wood handle, both gloved hands, sleeves, camera view, and realistic materials in their current positions. Keep the top sword panel and middle dagger panel unchanged. This is a static isolated equipment illustration. Preserve transparent alpha outside the subjects and the same three-panel portrait layout.
